name: Dungeon Finder: a full group whose finder state was lost can queue again
contract: A Dungeon Finder group keeps its LFG flag across a restart while the finder's own state does not: it comes back as state None.
LFGMgr::JoinLfg treats every LFG group that has not finished as continuing its dungeon and refuses a full group's continuation, so such a group could not queue until it disbanded.
LFGMgr::ReleaseAbandonedDungeon releases a full LFG group in state None whose members are not in its dungeon, so the queue starts a new role check and match.

steps.label: The group is a Dungeon Finder group for Deadmines without finder state, as after a restart
SETUP: the group has no finder state
The group queues for Random Classic Dungeon
DISCRIMINATING: the queue is accepted instead of refused as a continuation
